notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A browser-only, single-page tool that merges a well/plate metadata file with one or more plate-reader result files, shows a plate heatmap and grouped bar charts, computes screening statistics (Z-score, SSMD, Z', D-ratio, Welch p), 4PL EC50 and 2-way ANOVA, and exports merged CSVs and GraphPad Prism XY, Column or Grouped tables. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
